title: Concept: TLS protocol policy re-enabled every protocol in apache — review required
description: In apache, every protocol version is enabled at once. The directive overrides the library default, which already excludes obsolete versions, so the configuration recreates exposure the runtime had removed. Version negotiation picks the highest common version, but an attacker controls their own offer.
risk: Downgrade to a protocol with known cryptographic weaknesses; MEDIUM severity.
